_about: The switch of the checks' rules 19.7.2 (docs/PICWISE_CHECKS_RULES.md, section 19): how many of a shop's products pass to the site. true: no shop passes more than 20,000 products a card can show, chosen in the order of 19.4 (picwise_providers.shop_cap), before the cap of 15% a category; a pass counts for three nights (19.3.1); the bot asks a shop's shown products again first, in that order, and asks of a shop at most 20,000 (19.3.2, 19.3.3). false: none of it, the catalogue and the bot as before. Read with the code (prepared_catalogue._FROZEN_FILES): turning it prepares the catalogue again, and with it false the preparation leaves aside any wait of 'not passed in 3 nights' the bot wrote. True from 2026-11-23, on the owner's «Ανέβασε το» after the looks of 22/11 and 23/11 (section 20; the second on the checks' first real night). Turned to false only on his word: no shop is capped from the next preparation, but what the rule left out comes back through the checks' gate, as candidates the bot is asked, not at once (20.7.5).
